memberships.name: Non Profit Membership Level
benefits: Standard directory listing (contact details, phone, and website link)
Free access to monthly networking mixers and community roundtables
Ability to post community events on the chamber calendar
Access to member-to-member discounts and member job boards

memberships.name: Bronze
benefits: Official ribbon-cutting support and grand opening promotion
Inclusion in the quarterly new-member newsletter spotlight

memberships.name: Silver
benefits: Enhanced directory profile (company logo, media gallery, and extended bio)
Priority search placement in the online directory
Discounted rates on chamber event sponsorships

memberships.name: Gold
benefits: Featured homepage logo placement and top-tier directory positioning
1 dedicated promotional email blast per year sent to the entire chamber list
VIP tickets and priority seating at major annual events and luncheons
Direct access to regional leadership roundtables and policy advocacy briefings
